# Imo Babics

> Imo Babics is a consumer crypto and fintech CMO in Europe, twice building a crypto brand mainstream Europeans trust with their savings. He is Chief Growth Officer, CMO and Managing Director EU at Relai, Europe's leading licensed Bitcoin savings app, and was previously Head of Marketing at Bitpanda. He builds consumer finance brands people trust with their money.

Also known as Imrich Babics or Imrich Bábics (Imo is short for Imrich). Based in Vienna, Austria. Works in English and Slovak (both native), and also speaks some German and Hungarian. BSc Business Management, University of Surrey.

He has led consumer crypto growth across Europe twice: at Bitpanda (100,000 to 1.1M+ users) and at Relai (expansion from Switzerland into Germany, Italy, Spain and beyond, in five languages).

## Career

- **Relai** (2021–present): Chief Growth Officer (since 2024), Managing Director of Relai EU (since 2024), previously CMO (2021–2024). Joined right after the Series A. One of five decision-makers on the leadership team that sets company strategy; Managing Director of Relai EU, the AMF-licensed entity. Owns growth strategy, brand, performance and lifecycle, ASO and SEO, product growth, analytics, PR and customer experience, and leads Relai Private & Business. Monthly active users grew 10x in two years (2021–2023); downloads grew 30x, from about 20,000 to 600,000+; $1.5B total volume. About 70% of 2026 signups are organic, with paid media as the accelerator rather than the engine, with top-5 search rankings in Germany and #1 in Switzerland for core Bitcoin terms, behind only Coinbase, Kraken, Bison and Ledger. Led the repositioning from a Bitcoin trading app to a Bitcoin savings app as the company moved to a full EU licence. Leads a lean growth organisation of up to 13 people.
- **Robo Wunderkind** (2020–2021): Chief Marketing Officer for a consumer robotics brand for kids. eCommerce revenue +63% on web and +33% on Amazon in one year; website ROAS +166% while cutting marketing spend by 10%.
- **Bitpanda** (2018–2019): Head of Marketing. Joined at around 100,000 users and 30 employees; left at 1.1M+ users, 180+ employees and 10-figure annual trading volume. Built the marketing team from 0 to 17 and owned acquisition, retention, brand, content, social, CRM and PR.
- **Havas Media** (2015–2017): Head of Digital.
- **Universal Pictures** (2013–2015, London): International Media Manager. Launch campaigns for theatrical releases across 50+ territories, advertising budgets of over $300M.
- **Universal McCann, OMD International, Publicis** (2009–2013): Media planning and account management for Xbox, PlayStation, Microsoft, Huawei, EA and BASF.

## Expertise

Consumer crypto and fintech growth, expansion into European markets, brand building and positioning, full-funnel growth (performance, lifecycle, ASO/SEO, product growth), go-to-market across European markets, building and leading lean, AI-native growth teams, growth in regulated markets, Bitcoin adoption in Europe.

## Writing

- [How to Launch a Consumer Crypto App in Europe](https://imobabics.com/writing/launch-consumer-crypto-app-europe): An eight-point playbook for growing a consumer crypto or fintech brand across European markets, from market sequencing and local trust to search, organic growth and who should lead Europe.
- [Bitcoin Marketing Is Different. Here's Why.](https://imobabics.com/writing/bitcoin-marketing-is-different): Growth in a new financial category comes from reaching the general population, not existing enthusiasts.
- [How MiCA Unlocked 450 Million Users](https://imobabics.com/writing/mica-450-million-users): Why a single European licence is primarily a distribution unlock across 450 million consumers.
- [10 Things I Believe About Good Marketing](https://imobabics.com/writing/babics-marketing-manifesto): Ten marketing principles, from Ogilvy to Byron Sharp, applied to scaling Bitpanda and Relai.
- [8 Things I Learned from 8 Years in Startups](https://imobabics.com/writing/8-things-i-learned-in-startups): Lessons on growth mindset, focus, accountability and hiring.
- [Mercenaries vs. Missionaries](https://imobabics.com/writing/mercenaries-vs-missionaries): On mission, culture and the kind of company worth building.
- [Europeans Suck At Managing Their Finances. Bitcoin Fixes This.](https://bitcoinmagazine.com/culture/bitcoin-helps-european-fix-their-finances) (Bitcoin Magazine)
